title: Director of Practice and ASC Operations
text:
**Director of Practice and ASC Operations**

Reporting to: Chief Operating Officer

**About the Role**

Lead the day-to-day business operations of a multi-provider pain management practice and ambulatory surgery center (ASC). Your initial priorities will be to make it easier for patients and referring offices to reach us, convert more referrals into scheduled visits, and make better use of clinic and procedure capacity.

**A core part of the role is using data, technology, and automation to improve how the practice and ASC operate as they grow.** You’ll use call, referral, and scheduling data to see where patients get stuck and where capacity goes unused. You’ll then redesign workflows, improve how teams use existing systems, and automate repetitive steps such as routing callbacks or flagging referrals that need follow-up. You’ll measure whether those changes improve access, reduce manual work, and free up staff time.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll lead staff, set clear expectations, and work directly with physicians and the ASC Director of Nursing to improve how the practice and surgery center operate. We welcome leaders from healthcare and other complex service businesses. You’ll bring experience leading a team, using data to identify problems, and carrying changes through to measurable results.

**What You Bring**

**Required**

* Progressive operations leadership experience with direct responsibility for hiring, coaching, developing, and managing the performance of a team.
* Experience running a complex, customer-facing operation and managing the drivers of financial performance, such as labor, capacity, productivity, and operating expenses.
* A track record of personally leading workflow improvements that produced measurable, sustained results in access, service, efficiency, or cost.
* Experience using data and KPIs to identify bottlenecks, prioritize action, and verify that changes improved performance.
* Experience using technology or automation to simplify workflows, reduce manual work, and help staff adopt new ways of working.
* Ability to lead changes that span teams, take ownership when progress stalls, and work hands-on with frontline staff to resolve problems.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.

**What success looks like**

* **Better patient access.** Make it easier for patients to connect with us and stay engaged throughout their care. Answer more calls live, return messages promptly, and offer convenient online scheduling for eligible visits. Use technology alongside personal outreach to keep patients informed, respond to their needs, and support them throughout their care.
* **Growth and capacity.** Grow completed visits and procedures by strengthening relationships with referring providers, making it easy to refer patients, and keeping referring offices informed. Convert more referrals into completed visits and procedures through timely scheduling, better use of clinic and ASC capacity, and fewer avoidable cancellations.
* **Stronger financial performance.** Labor and supply costs managed to budget, with timely resolution of operational issues affecting collections.
* **Less manual work and clearer accountability.** Use technology and automation to simplify workflows. Set clear ownership for follow-up and use data to track whether changes improve performance and hold over time.

**Preferred**

* Experience in physician practice management, ambulatory surgery, or another regulated service environment.
* Experience coordinating operations across locations or across teams with distinct professional responsibilities.

**Candidates from outside healthcare are encouraged to apply.** Leadership experience and a record of improving operations are essential. Physician practice management experience is optional.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person
